records.text: Nevada law allows girls at Courage House Nevada to remain until age 21 rather than leave at 18.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: and they specifically outline how excited they are that Nevada has changed its laws. which means that they don't have to leave on their 18th birthday, that those girls can now stay until they're 21.

verification.notes: Local reporting says Courage House Nevada residents may live there until age 21, and Nevada law recognizes under-21 psychiatric residential services. The stronger causal claim that Nevada law specifically creates this program rule, contrasted with mandatory departure at 18, is not established.
